verdict.rationale: Buzz documents creating rooms that can be made private and a CLI flag (`--visibility open`) for public channels. Channels have explicit memberships, including per-agent channel memberships, and its benchmark includes inviting users into a newly created channel, all on NIP-29 relay-based groups. The community critique of the private-group permission model is a hypothetical, not a documented failure, so it does not create a dispute. Missing for 10: detailed docs on membership controls (adding/removing members, roles, join policies for private channels), independent hands-on corroboration.
